integrity: Exact finite formulas have self-contained mathematical proofs and direct small-case checks. Publication priority is assessed against accessible sources only; no independent audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The all-rank nilpotent index census and maximal-index theorem concern bipartition sizes a,b at least two. The star specialization is prior, no asymptotic distribution is established, and equivalence to an undiscovered colored-partial-permutation formula remains possible. The square K_{2,2}=C_4 instance is already implied by an earlier complete cycle nilpotency-index theorem and is not independently original.
title: Alternating-chain census and a sharp nilpotency-index phase transition for complete bipartite partial isometries
